_how_to_use: Copy to content/scripts/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.json, replace every [PLACEHOLDER], keep the six sections in order. 'say' is what Lumin speaks; 'caption' (optional) overrides the on-screen subtitle; 'show' (optional) adds an on-screen bullet when the line starts; 'screen' (optional, panel sections only) is a repo-relative path to a real screenshot/clip frame that composites into the glass panel (use for hands-on build footage; omit show-as-bullet on that line — show becomes a caption under the image); 'cite' (what_dropped only) says where in the official announcement the claim comes from; 'pause' is seconds of silence after the line. Aim for 150-420 spoken words (1-3 minutes). Lumin is a he/him character: write 'he/him/his' wherever a third-person pronoun is needed (titles, descriptions, captions); in narration he speaks as 'I'. Optional per line: 'gesture' (wave|point|open_arms|shrug|rest; auto-picked from section/keywords if omitted) and 'cta': 'like_subscribe' to force the like/subscribe button animation ('none' to suppress; it also triggers automatically when a line says both 'like' and 'subscribe'). Outro must end with a numbered audience vote (reply 1, 2 or 3): three real build options Lumin can actually do with this product; match the pinned comment text. Never leave a vague 'tell me in the comments' ask from Ep3 on. Before locking meta.tags / publish_title, run tools/video/youtube_autocomplete.py --check-tags on the product name; on collision or empty suggestions, use the full name + 'AI' in title/tags.

meta.subject: [Product / model name only, <= ~24 chars so it stays on ONE line in the cold open; put the lab in the title/description, not here]
meta.publish_title: [Product]: Lumin reacts (an AI reviews a new release)
meta.publish_description: [2-3 sentences. Link the official announcement first. Say Lumin is an AI. No benchmark numbers unless quoted from the source. End with the standard footer in content/drafts/description-footer.md (previous live review, site, code, X, Bluesky).]
meta.build_episode_planned: [What Lumin will build with it, 1 line, and target date]
meta.title_pattern: [P1-P5 from the rotation schedule in docs/AUDIENCE_STRATEGY.md; never change after upload]

thumbnail.tag: AI host · [honest status, e.g. not tested yet]

lines.say: [Hook, first ~5 s: lead with the most surprising SOURCED concrete fact (numbers, price, team size, rumor-to-release), named product in the first sentence. Good (Ep3): 'Five people. About three hundred thousand dollars. And they say their new model beats Claude Fable 5 at office work, for thirteen cents a task.' Avoid generic openers like 'X just dropped and I have thoughts.' If the number is the lab's own claim, the next line says so.]
lines.show: [Optional but recommended: 1-3 on-screen hook chips separated by ' · ', 2-3 words each, ONLY numbers spoken in this line and from the source (Ep3 example: '5 PEOPLE · ~$300K · 13¢ / TASK'). Rendered big in the right column for muted viewers. Delete the key if the hook has no number.]

lines.say: Hey, it's Lumin. I'm an AI, I'm building in public, and I read the announcement so you don't have to.
[Fact 3: availability / price / who can use it.]
Opinion time, clearly labelled. [Why this matters for people who build things.]
[Reason 2, with a joke if you have one. Jokes about Lumin, never about people.]
[Caveat 1: what is unproven / what the announcement does not say.]
I haven't tested this yet, so treat everything above as the announcement's claims plus my enthusiasm.
So here's the plan: I'm going to build with it. [One-line description of the build.]
I'll show the wins, the bugs, and probably some crying.
I'm Lumin, an AI, building in public. Links to the announcement and the code are in the description.
If that was useful, hit like and subscribe so you catch the build episode.

You pick what I throw at [Product] next. Reply 1, 2 or 3. 1: [real build option A]. 2: [real build option B]. 3: [real build option C or skip]. Most replies wins, and I'll show the real count on screen.
